summary.zh: 不只做得快，还要判断哪张单值得先做。
summary.en: Decide which order deserves attention first, not only how fast to cook.

rules.zh: 多个订单同时等待，制作耗时不同，耐心或截止时间持续下降。玩家选择处理顺序并交付匹配菜品，及时服务获得收益，延误则失去奖励或结束营业。
rules.en: Several orders wait at once with different preparation times and shrinking patience or deadlines. Players prioritize and deliver matching dishes; timely service earns rewards, while delays lose rewards or end the run.

decisions.zh: 先做快到期的复杂单，还是先清掉两个快单？
decisions.en: Finish the urgent complex order or clear two quick ones?

decisions.zh: 为了守住连单奖励，是否值得放弃更方便的顺序？
decisions.en: Is preserving a service streak worth an inconvenient order?

effect.zh: 差异越大越需要动态调度；相同时间容易退化为队列。
effect.en: Varied deadlines require dynamic scheduling; identical ones tend toward a simple queue.

effect.zh: 单次失误只扣分允许冒险；一桌离开就结束会鼓励保险计划。
effect.en: Score-only penalties allow risk; run-ending abandonment encourages conservative planning.

implementation.zh: 上方订单有等待进度，玩家完成指定料理并交付；连续按序服务与及时交付影响表现。
implementation.en: Orders appear with waiting progress; players prepare specified dishes, with timely and ordered service affecting performance.

observation.zh: 厨房工位被空间隔开，订单调度必须考虑往返。系统参考图，不显示耐心变化。
observation.en: Separated stations make travel part of scheduling. System reference; patience changes are not shown.

implementation.zh: 顾客在等位、点餐与等菜等阶段有耐心压力；任一顾客失去耐心会导致营业失败，因此需要照顾整个服务链。
implementation.en: Customers have patience pressures across waiting and service stages; losing a customer ends the restaurant run, making the whole service chain relevant.

observation.zh: 大厅里多组顾客同时等候，厨房与服务必须共享处理能力。系统参考图。
observation.en: Several customer groups wait at once, sharing kitchen and service capacity. System reference.

contrast.zh: 胡闹厨房主要用分数和订单连贯性施压；PlateUp 把最不耐烦的顾客变成整局的短板。
contrast.en: Overcooked pressures scores and order flow; PlateUp makes the least-patient customer a run-ending bottleneck.

combination.zh: 组合创意：顾客可接受一次解释性延期，玩家用有限的人情额度交换更合理的出餐顺序。
combination.en: Design proposal: customers accept one explained delay, letting limited goodwill buy scheduling flexibility.

setup.zh: 两张单快到期：汤要20秒，沙拉只要5秒。
setup.en: Two orders are nearly due: soup takes twenty seconds and salad takes five.

action.zh: 你先交沙拉清掉一张单，再集中处理汤。
action.en: Deliver the salad first to clear one order, then focus on soup.

result.zh: 短单完成释放压力，但汤的剩余耐心也更少。
result.en: The quick order is cleared, but the soup customer now has less patience.

next.zh: 新单加入后重新评估，不能永远只做最短的一张。
next.en: Reassess when a new order arrives; shortest-first is not always best.

firstStep.zh: 做三个同时倒计时的订单卡和固定制作时长，先用点击选择制作对象。
firstStep.en: Use three countdown order cards and fixed preparation times, selecting work with a click.

pitfall.zh: 别先增加大量菜谱；不同工时与截止时间已足够验证调度决策。
pitfall.en: A large menu is unnecessary initially; varied durations and deadlines can already test scheduling choices.

test.zh: 改变一张订单的剩余耐心，玩家是否会调整顺序，而不是照出现次序完成？
test.en: When one deadline changes, do players reprioritise instead of following arrival order?
